doc.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Teaching the Concept: gravity and the Lydian scale
title: Gravity, the overtone series and why theory chose the major scale
summary: He explains tonal gravity and the 11th overtone, claims Western theory chose the diatonic scale for marches, and says he found the science missing for 400 years.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Is the f an octave away from that 11th overtone? You said overtone.
Yeah.
You didn’t say the 11th. Okay. All right.
The 11th overtone is very far from the tonic.
From the f.
Yeah.
So it was at that point in the hospital that you started thinking about chord- scale unity and about gravity.
And about gravity, and about Miles.
In your mind, were you calling it gravity at the time?
Um-hmm.
Okay, interesting.
Calling it gravity. For 400 years, the founding fathers of Western music omitted.
Why was that? Why was that that all of a sudden everything became diatonic, and all the focus was on the major scale and the minor scale, just those?
Well, they need marches to march people into the various wars that were happening. That’s one answer.

That’s a good answer, though, when you think about how the times can be manipulated. So that, the major scale and the minor, to the exclusion of everything else, became the order of the day. This word “diatonic” seemed to be elevated all of a sudden.
“Dia” means two, two tonics. The major scale is a two tonic scale, whatever two tonic means.
Then for the next 400 years . . .
They missed it.
. . . this is forgotten about, the other modes.

It fell on me, alone, to discover that they – their decision had no science to it at all. It was not an objective summation to come to. It was subjective. Somebody heard [Russell again sings an ascending major scale, dividing it in half] and said, oh, that sounds nice. That’s the way it is. But oddly enough, some very good music has come out of the major scale. So you can’t say it’s – you can’t put it down. You can accept it within – the major scale is within the Lydian scale. The Lydian scale keeps its stature as the foundation of a science. The major scale has no science and it fell on me, after 400 years of this and that person trying, but always coming up with some dildo answer. They’ve never been able to answer it scientifically. I’ve got a science.
